page.layout: One scanned object: a book in a wrapper of limp parchment or vellum, seen from the front. No printed text block. A handwritten title near the top, a pencilled mark in the middle, and a paper shelf label at the foot.
page.notes: No printed text on this scan. The page shows the wrapper of a book, not a printed page. The handwritten title in brown ink near the top reads "ARLIS. Tomus II" (the first word may be "ARTIS"; I cannot be certain). The pencilled marks in the middle are handwriting and are left out. The paper label at the foot carries the shelf mark "Ca 251", which is left out as a library shelf mark.
